jobs.description:
Our technical OT/ICS team is expanding, so we're looking for a senior technical consultant to join an ambitious cybersecurity team working with clients across the globe.

**What You'll Do

**You'll join a team of highly skilled engineers and consultants working at the intersection of IT, Operational Technology (OT), automation, and cybersecurity – with protecting and monitoring OT networks at the core of what we do.

**In This Role, You'll Own

**

• Advanced threat detection and engineering: working extensively with industry-leading technology providers to deploy, test, and tune advanced threat monitoring solutions in production environments

• Technical implementation: leading the design and implementation of OT network segmentation projects, architecture redesign, secure remote access integration, and asset/configuration analysis

• Consultancy and advisory: acting as trusted advisor to clients and colleagues on architecture reviews and OT risk assessments, and translating technical risk into business impact

**What You'll Bring

**We're looking for a seasoned OT Cybersecurity Principal Consultant with extensive experience in infrastructure solutions and technology deployment in OT environments.

**The Ideal Candidate Comes With

**

• At least 5 years of experience in OT/ICS cybersecurity, including client-facing consulting roles

• Demonstrated capability across critical security domains such as network segmentation, IDS/IPS, endpoint security, secure remote access, incident response, cyber threat intelligence, and Security Operations Centre enablement

• A track record of continuous technical development — for example, certifications such as GICSP, GRID, ISA/IEC, CCNA/CCNP, or product certifications with recognised OT security vendors such as Nozomi or Claroty

Clearance for SECRET (HEMMELIGT) with Danish authorities is a plus.

**What We Offer

**We're a growing and ambitious tech startup that puts technical excellence first. We invest in the tools, tradecraft, and certifications needed to stay at the forefront of our domains, and continuously sharpen our expertise.

You'll join a team of highly skilled specialists working on complex OT cybersecurity challenges, helping shape both our capabilities and the services we bring to market.

**About The Tech Collective

**The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement Consulting Group. We aim to make a positive difference in the consulting industry, believing that the ability to create change with impact and purpose is a prerequisite for success in a global and turbulent world.

For any questions about the position, contact Anders Rømer at anrs@thetechcollective.eu.

Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for a Senior M365 Security Engineer to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists in our Secure Infrastructure domain.

About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company

Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.

Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.

Today, we employ around 350 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for a Senior M365 Security Engineer who wants to make a difference in our Secure Infrastructure domain.

Secure Infrastructure

Looking at the actual threat landscape today, it’s more important than ever to design and build infrastructure solutions that incorporate correct and relevant security features. The team works closely together using their combined knowledge and experience gathered from different projects and Incident Response cases to help our customers stay ahead of the threat actors. We continuously help customers improve their security posture within cloud, data center, endpoint management, identity, M365, and networking.

The Role

Truesec is looking for a Senior Microsoft 365 Security Engineer to our Secure Infrastructure team. The role interfaces regularly with team members and customers to determine technical requirements, feasibility of projects and expectations. You are responsible for maintaining, implementing, and designing client-facing solutions across Microsoft 365 Security and Azure.

This role is for someone who wants to be hands-on in a technical role across Cloud Security, Identity Security and Data Security. You will work with security configurations and policies within M365 and Entra ID, while also configuring and optimizing Microsoft Purview capabilities. You will help customers protect users, identities, devices and critical data across Microsoft 365 services including Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams and endpoints.

You will work closely with security specialists across Secure Infrastructure and have the opportunity to contribute to projects that combine M365 security, Purview and broader security initiatives.

Other responsibilities you might have can be:

• Run health and security checks within M365, Entra ID and Microsoft Purview

• Configure and optimize security and data protection policies across Microsoft 365 services

• Provide customers recommendations and prioritization of how to improve their security and data protection posture over time

• Implement solutions based on Statement of Work with customers

• Deliver training and workshops to clients and colleagues within M365 security best practices

Your Potential Background

We believe that your background probably entails 5+ years of experience and expertise within the Microsoft public cloud, such as M365 Security, Entra ID, Intune and Microsoft Purview, including troubleshooting, deploying and configuring of said solutions. It’s likely that you have worked with a combination of identity, cloud security and data security, including areas such as Conditional Access, Defender, Microsoft Information Protection, sensitivity labeling, encryption, rights management, data classification and Data Loss Prevention.

You are comfortable working hands-on with technical configurations while also being able to explain security concepts, risks and recommended actions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Required Skills:

• Strong experience of the M365 Security platform

• Strong experience of Entra ID

• Ability to script and automate using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph or related APIs

• Experience working with Microsoft security services such as Defender, Conditional Access or Intune

• Ability to prioritize and create implementation plans for customers

• Strong communication skills and ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

• Comfortable in conducting trainings and workshops to clients and colleagues within M365 security best practices

• Knowledge in Microsoft Purview

Bonus Skills:

• Experience within Client Management

• Understanding of M365 licensing, including licensing related to Microsoft Purview and Compliance features

• Experience with hybrid environments

• Experience with Insider Risk Management, Communication Compliance, Audit, eDiscovery or retention policies in Microsoft Purview

• Familiarity with regulatory compliance requirements such as GDPR, NIS2, ISO 27001 or similar data protection regulations

Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Danish citizenship, citizenship in an EU country, or a Danish work permit.

Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future

If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you'll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company - and learn from some of the best in their field.

So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

Hos Awaze hjälper vi människor att komma iväg på semester – och det kan vi bara göra tack vare våra engagerade husägare. Vi söker två nya kollegor som kanske studerar just nu och vill ha ett flexibelt extrajobb med möjlighet att arbeta både dag- och eftermiddagstid. Vi söker dig som talar flytande norska eller svenska samt danska och som vill vara med och bygga starka relationer, säkerställa hög kundnöjdhet och behålla våra husägares förtroende.

Ditt uppdrag

Som vår nya Customer Experience Specialist blir ditt uppdrag att säkerställa en professionell, förtroendefull och värdeskapande upplevelse för våra husägare genom hela deras resa med NOVASOL.

Du blir en del av ett ambitiöst och samarbetsinriktat team som brinner för att skapa goda relationer och leverera service av hög kvalitet. Oavsett om det handlar om att besvara förfrågningar, ge råd om intäkter eller introducera nya husägare får du en central roll i att säkerställa att våra husägare väljer att stanna hos oss – och trivs med det.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

• 
Vara den primära kontaktpersonen för husägare via telefon och e-post

• 
Hantera både enkla och komplexa förfrågningar – med fokus på att lösa ärenden redan vid första kontakten

• 
Bygga upp och vårda relationer med husägare och ge dem en positiv upplevelse hos NOVASOL

• 
Ge husägare råd om hur de kan optimera sitt semesterhus och sina intäkter

• 
Säkerställa korrekt rådgivning och hög kvalitet i all kommunikation

Profilen vi söker

Du kommer att trivas i den här rollen om du motiveras av att prata med människor, skapa relationer och hitta lösningar – även när uppgifterna är komplexa.

Vi söker en kollega som kan bidra med:

• 
Stark kommunikationsförmåga och en naturlig känsla för kundservice

• 
Förmåga att bygga förtroende och professionella relationer

• 
Ett nyfiket och lärande förhållningssätt – du vill ständigt utvecklas

• 
Ett problemlösande och positivt förhållningssätt där utmaningar ses som möjligheter

• 
Ett samarbetsinriktat och proaktivt sätt att få saker gjorda

Så lyckas du i rollen

• 
Säkerställer hög nöjdhet och lojalitet bland våra husägare

• 
Levererar professionell rådgivning som skapar värde för både husägare och verksamheten

• 
Bygger starka relationer som stärker förtroendet för NOVASOL och Awaze

• 
Bidrar aktivt till teamets prestationer och gemensamma kommersiella resultat

• 
Utvecklar dina kompetenser genom kontinuerligt lärande och erfarenhetsutbyte

• 
Talar flytande norska eller svenska och gärna danska

Därför vill du arbeta hos Awaze

Vi erbjuder en varierad tjänst i en stark professionell och social miljö som du får möjlighet att påverka. Du blir en del av ett internationellt företag som investerar i framtiden och arbetar målmedvetet med utveckling – både av verksamheten och våra medarbetare.

Du kan bland annat se fram emot:

• 
Attraktiva rabatter på semesterboenden för dig, din familj och dina vänner

• 
Grundlig introduktion och utbildning i våra produkter och system

• 
Goda möjligheter till professionell och personlig utveckling över olika roller och länder

• 
Att bli en del av en mångsidig och inkluderande arbetsmiljö

• 
Ett engagerat team med passionerade chefer och kollegor

• 
Lunchordning samt träningsmöjligheter på kontoret

Om Awaze

Vårt uppdrag är tydligt – att skapa fantastiska semesterupplevelser med Europas största utbud av semesterboenden.

Med mer än 110 000 boenden runt om i Europa är vi marknadsledande inom uthyrning av semesterhus. Vår ambition är inte bara att vara störst, utan att vara den mest uppskattade och bästa leverantören av semesterboenden i Europa.

Resebranschen är i ständig utveckling och vi fokuserar på att forma nästa kapitel. Vi stärker kontinuerligt relationerna med våra gäster och husägare, utvecklar vårt sätt att arbeta och levererar starka resultat. Genom att göra våra processer enklare och mer effektiva bygger vi en organisation som är rustad för framtiden – driven av stolta, passionerade och inkluderande medarbetare.

Bra att veta

• 
Arbetsplats: Contact Center i Skejby, Hedeager 44, 8200 Aarhus N

• 
Gratis parkering samt enkel tillgång till spårväg och buss

• 
Anställningen innebär att inget bestämt antal arbetstimmar garanteras, vilket också ger dig stor flexibilitet att planera din tid. Eftersom vi arbetar i en säsongsbetonad verksamhet där människor åker på semester året runt finns det alltid mycket att göra. Särskilt under vår högsäsong på sommaren finns det möjlighet att arbeta många pass.

Vad händer härnäst?

Om det här låter som rätt nästa steg för dig, klicka på ”Ansök” och följ instruktionerna för att skicka in din ansökan. Vi anpassar vår rekryteringsprocess efter varje enskild roll för att ge både dig och vårt rekryteringsteam de bästa förutsättningarna att bedöma om detta kan bli början på ett bra samarbete. Du hör från oss så snart vi har gått igenom din ansökan.

Vi är engagerade i att säkerställa en inkluderande och tillgänglig rekryteringsprocess. Alla ansökningar behandlas likvärdigt. Om du har särskilda behov eller önskemål inför intervjun är du varmt välkommen att informera oss när du tackar ja till inbjudan – vi gör gärna de anpassningar som behövs.

jobs.occupation: Student Assistant – Social Media and Event Planning
jobs.description:
About us

At Danske Spil, we work with games, dreams and entertainment – and our profits go to sports and voluntary associations. In BDI, Business Development & Innovation, we develop new gaming products that go beyond the traditional. We test fast, learn and fail.

You will be exposed to the entire value chain: from idea to launch to sales optimization. Here, success is measured by what we bring to market – not by the number of ideas.

Your role

Working closely with the innovation team, you will help bring new gaming products to life on social media – from planning content to executing launches and keeping the momentum going afterwards. You will help shape and execute our social media strategy around new products.

What you will be doing

• 
Developing and executing social media campaigns for product launches and market tests

• 
Creating inspiring content (posts, stories, video ideas, graphics) for Instagram, TikTok and other relevant channels

• 
Supporting event planning and execution for product launches, from concept to hands-on delivery

• 
Analysing social media performance and keeping up with trends to bring fresh ideas for engagement

• 
Automating marketing tasks, plus various administrative tasks

Who are you?

You have more than a year left of your studies and experience with social media and events. You have a creative mind, you are curious by nature, and you are not afraid to ask questions along the way.

• 
You love social media and understand how to create engagement across different platforms

• 
You are creative and able to work in a structured way

• 
You are proactive and ask questions

• 
You are curious about working in a cross-functional team and about events, and see the potential in combining physical and digital activities

• 
You are interested in how AI can be used in marketing

Preferred fields of study

• 
Communication and Culture

• 
Digital Marketing or Business and Marketing

• 
Media and Information Studies

• 
Event Management or Branding and Strategic Communication

• 
Creative Technology / Digital Design

Practical details

The hourly wage is DKK 174 as a bachelor’s student and DKK 179 as a master’s student on weekdays. The expected working time is 12–16 hours per week. Your working hours are agreed with your closest manager, but we know that your studies come first, so we will of course take exam periods into account.

We read applications on an ongoing basis, but the deadline to apply is 26 November 2026. If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Jesper Kildegaard, Head of Innovation, at JEKP@danskespil.dk. If you have questions about the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact HR Business Partner Majbritt Storm Lindegaard at MASB@danskespil.dk.

Do you have experience developing medical devices or other regulated products? Are you skilled at translating clinical and business needs into clear priorities for technical teams? Would you like to help develop innovative AI solutions that can improve patients’ lives?

Then your next career move may be as Product Owner for AI Development at Ambu.

AI Development at Ambu

You will join the Algorithms department within Software & Electronics in Ambu’s global R&D organization. The department develops advanced AI and algorithmic solutions for Ambu’s endoscopy products and includes specialists in deep learning, image processing, and data engineering.

You will be Product Owner for a cross-functional Agile team consisting of AI developers, data engineers, and a Test & Verification engineer. The team participates in Ambu’s Scaled Agile Release Train, ART, and collaborates closely with other teams and stakeholders.

The position is based in either Ballerup, Denmark, or Augsburg, Germany. You will report to Lee Lassen, AI Manager, who is part of the Algorithms leadership organization under the Head of Algorithms.

Your Role

As Product Owner, you will maximize the value delivered by the AI development team. You will translate product objectives, clinical needs, technical opportunities, and regulatory requirements into a clear and prioritized backlog.

You will work closely with Product Management, engineering managers, architects, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, project stakeholders, and other Product Owners across the ART.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Own, prioritize, and maintain the team backlog in alignment with product priorities and ART objectives.

• Translate clinical, product, technical, quality, and regulatory needs into clear features, user stories, enablers, and acceptance criteria.

• Participate actively in PI Planning and support the definition and delivery of realistic, value-driven PI objectives.

• Coordinate priorities and dependencies with Product Management, architects, other Product Owners, Agile teams, and relevant stakeholders.

• Guide the cross-functional team through AI development activities spanning data preparation, model development, testing, verification, and product release.

• Monitor progress, risks, and dependencies while supporting design control, continuous improvement, and effective Agile ways of working.

Occasional travel between Ambu sites and other development locations should be expected for up to 20 days / year.

Suggested Candidate Profile

You are proactive, structured, and committed to delivering value. You enjoy working with technical specialists and can balance product, clinical, technical, regulatory, and business considerations.

You are likely to succeed in this position if you have:

• A relevant degree in engineering, computer science, data science, biomedical engineering, or a related technical field.

• Experience as a Product Owner, technical Product Manager, project lead, or in a similar product-development role.

• Experience with medical devices or another regulated industry, including design control, requirements, risk management, and verification.

• Experience with Agile development and preferably working within a Scaled Agile Framework, SAFe, organization.

• A good understanding of AI, machine learning, data engineering, software development, or other data-driven product development.

• Strong communication, stakeholder-management, and prioritization skills, with the ability to create clarity across technical and cross-functional teams.

As Ambu is a global company, fluency in English is essential. All applications must be submitted in English.

How to Apply

We invite candidates for interviews on a continuous basis, so do not hesitate to apply.

For additional information about the position and Ambu, please contact:

**Lee Lassen

**AI Team Manager

Ambu A/S

leel@ambu.com

Your application will be treated confidentially.

Ambu: A Visionary and International Workplace Where Your Efforts Matter

Ambu is a rapidly growing company with ambitious goals. We achieve them through interdisciplinary collaboration between motivated and highly skilled employees.

By joining us, you will work in an international and collaborative environment where your contribution matters. We offer exciting professional challenges, strong development opportunities, and a broad range of professional, social, and financial employee benefits.

**Location:

**Copenhagen, Denmark

**Job ID:

**R1010024

**Date Posted:

**2026-10-28

**Company Name:

**Hitachi Rail Denmark A/S

**Profession (Job Category):

**Engineering & Science

**Job Schedule:

**Full time

**Hybrid

**About Us

**A career at Hitachi Rail will help create a legacy. With operations in every corner of the world, our work goes to the cutting-edge of digital transformation and technology. From the multi-cultural strength of our global organisation to the sustainable and innovative ways we work to bring people together, there’s something for everyone to get stuck into. And that’s where you come in.

**Job Description:

****Solution Architect

****About The F-Bane Programme

**The F-Bane Programme is a landmark project driven by Banedanmark, focused on upgrading Denmark’s railway network by introducing the European Train Control System (ETCS) Level 2. This modernisation effort is being delivered in the western part of the country by a Joint Venture between Hitachi Rail GTS Denmark and Strukton.

Our goal? Replace outdated analogue signalling systems with cutting-edge digital solutions - improving safety, increasing capacity, and enabling more reliable and punctual train service across Jutland. This is a key step in Denmark’s journey to becoming a global frontrunner in sustainable, intelligent rail transport.

**About The Role & Our Team

**As a Solution Architect, you’ll take a pivotal role in shaping the technical direction and implementation of ETCS L2. You’ll work at the intersection of engineering, system architecture, and project execution - collaborating with internal design teams, Hitachi subsidiaries, suppliers, and partners.

This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys connecting high-level strategy with practical implementation and thrives in a diverse, international environment where teamwork, structure, and creativity coexist.

**Key Responsibilities

**You’ll play a key role in the delivery of Denmark’s next-generation digital rail network. Responsibilities include:

• Align Engineering requirements on the specific Railway signaling and ETCS Level 2 design

• Align the specific signaling design with the features delivered by the generic system in close collaboration with the generic solution architect

• Coordinating technical activities with all internal stakeholders and suppliers to ensure alignment on the signaling and ETCS design.

• Maintain and review and adjust the engineering process for continuous improvement

• Creating and updating Rules and Guidelines that support solution architecture and design.

• Prepare Solutions for Change Requests and contributing to change impact analysis.

• Approving technical deliverables to the project management

• Participating in Defect Management Boards and Change Control Boards, providing technical assessments and solutions.

**Who We’re Looking For

**We are looking for an experienced Solution Architect with expertise in ETCS and railway signaling systems. The ideal candidate combines strong technical knowledge with excellent communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and a passion for delivering high-impact solutions.

**Qualifications & Experience

**

• 5+ years’ experience in railway signaling and ETCS.

• 5+ years’ experience in railway operations and principles

• Proven experience in a similar role (system design, complex systems architecture, project engineering, validation or operational safety) in the transportation sector or an equivalent field.

• Ability to solve technical problems and analytical thinking, while demonstrating creativity and autonomy in decision-making.

• Excellent interpersonal skills and a passion for collaborative work and technical management. You enjoy coordinating teams, are open-minded, and comfortable presenting to clients.

• Fluent in English; Danish is a plus

**What It’s Like To Work With Us

**

• A flexible hybrid working model (main office in Ballerup)

• A collaborative and international team that values shared knowledge and respect

• A workplace committed to continuous learning and development

• The opportunity to help shape the future of sustainable transport in Denmark

**Workin in Hitachi:

**Our employees are our most important asset and we provide an environment that encourages a healthy work/life balance and we offer a flexible hybrid work environment based on Working from home and office presence (40/60). Your manager will interact with you on a regular basis, ensuring you a career path that suits your needs and ambitions. Beside the traditional benefits like pension, 6 weeks of holidays, canteen etc., we also are proud of offering some good and very professional skilled colleagues.

Thank you for your interest in Hitachi Rail. If your application is of interest, we will be in contact. Please do not hesitate to discover more about us and our latest jobs at https://www.hitachirail.com/careers**.

**At Hitachi Rail, there is a place for everyone. We welcome and value differences in background, age, gender, sexuality, family status, disability, race, nationality, ethnicity, religion, and world view. **It is our commitment to create an inclusive environment - we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

****We would be delighted if you would be one of our followers at https://www.linkedin.com/company/hitachirail

Our client is a fast-growing international software company. It is a global leader in its field and is growing by more than 25% every year. The company has the ambition to more than triple in size over the next four to five years. The company is owned by a private equity fund and is anonymous in this advertisement. To lead sales performance and lead generation, we are now looking for a

Head of Growth

High impact – Growth journey – Sales performance

Do you want to be the right hand of the CEO, with overall responsibility for sales performance and lead generation across an international group? And do you want to be a close sparring partner for both the CEO and the private equity owner while the company sets out to more than triple in size?

As Head of Growth you take on a central, high-impact role, where you lead sales teams and inside sales teams together with the country heads. You will own the full lead life cycle: you build and run performance management across the funnel (lead generation, MQLs, SQLs and conversion) and you are also accountable for generating MQLs and SQLs, as the Lead Generation Manager reports directly to you. You measure the effectiveness of marketing, inside sales and sales through pipeline reporting against budget at group, country and individual level.

The role is international and requires a presence within the EU. The location is flexible within Denmark.

Reporting to the Group CEO, your responsibilities will include:

• Own lead generation: lead and develop the Lead Generation Manager and be accountable for the volume and quality of MQLs and SQLs delivered to the sales teams

• Adapt, refine and align the sales funnel and sales process across business units, enabling best-practice sharing and sales problem-solving (knowledge of HubSpot and sales operations is a benefit)

• Drive sales team performance by instilling a culture of accountability, motivation and resilience, and by challenging the teams to achieve more

• Test new sales approaches, refine pitches and explore new methods

• Build a high-performing sales culture and develop the company’s sales playbook, including training, motivation and team development

• Scale sales strategies across multiple European markets and roll out a consistent playbook while allowing for local differences

• Act as a close sparring partner to the CEO and the private equity owner, including performance reporting and follow-up

To succeed in the role, you have 5–15 years of sales experience as both a sales rep and a sales manager, ideally in B2B SaaS or SME-focused sales. You are a high-energy, hands-on, front-line leader who thrives in high-growth environments and who regularly motivates, coaches and develops sales teams to top performance. You are comfortable with modern sales tools and can work across many stakeholders, including a private equity owner. You are fluent in English, and German is an advantage.

You are highly analytical and performance-driven, curious, and thorough when it comes to process and detail. You are known for your energy, your ability to bring people with you and your willingness to stand your ground.

Anonymity, private equity ownership and NDA

The company is anonymous in this advertisement and is owned by a private equity fund. As the role involves close and ongoing interaction with the fund, it is important to us that you know about the ownership structure from the start. We work with an NDA (non-disclosure agreement). The first conversation with Sensu takes place without an NDA. Before you meet the company, you sign an NDA, after which you receive full information about the company, its ownership and the role.

Are you our new Head of Growth? Then please upload your application and CV. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, sexuality, ethnicity and religion. For further information about the position, please contact Thomas Bech, CEO at Sensu, on +45 22 89 89 76.

Please note that we do not work with application deadlines, as applications are processed on a rolling basis.

Senior Global Leadership Development Manager

**People, leadership & performance

****Bagsvaerd, Denmark

**Are you passionate about leadership development and organisational growth? Do you have the skills to design and deliver impactful leadership initiatives on a global scale?

If you are ready to make a difference and collaborate with diverse stakeholders across the globe, we want you to join our team as a Senior Global Leadership Development Manager.

Read more and apply today!

Your new role

As a Senior Global Leadership Development Manager, you will :

• Deliver and execute leadership development priorities within assigned EVP/SVP areas or geographies through interventions for leadership teams and larger groups of leaders.

• Design and facilitate interventions using sparring, facilitation, coaching, and consultation to build leader capability in line with enterprise expectations.

• Act as the primary point of contact for designated EVP areas or geographies to support Lines of Business (LoB) and local People & Organisation (P&O) teams in developing and delivering contextualised leadership development solutions.

• Implement global processes, development offerings, and standards locally, adapting global content to local contexts while maintaining alignment with global leadership frameworks.

• Collaborate with HR Business Partners and business leaders to identify leadership capability gaps and co-create targeted interventions.

• Lead innovation in leadership development by identifying, piloting, and scaling new learning approaches.

Your new department

You will be part of Novo Nordisk’ Global Leadership & Learning Center of Excellence, joining the GlobalLeadership Execution team, which consists of 9 dedicated colleagues situated both in our HQ and in different locations around the world. Based in a dynamic and collaborative environment, our team works closely with global stakeholders to shape Novo Nordisk's leadership; equipping leaders at all levels to champion change, turn strategy into real results and build an engaging learning environment for all.

**Your Skills And Qualifications

**We are looking for a candidate with the following qualifications :

• A Master’s degree in business, HR, Psychology, or a similar field.

• +10 years of proven HR experience in two or more specialised HR functions (e.g., talent development, leadership development, learning & development, performance management, HRBP).

• Strong expertise in partnering with HR business partners and line leaders to design and implement solutions.

• Experience in leadership development and/or business HR consulting.

• Effective communication skills, including written, oral, and presentation skills.

• Strategic thinking, stakeholder influence, and relationship-building skills.

• Cultural intelligence and adaptability in a global and matrixed environment

**Nice To Have

**Experience from geographical areas other than your home country. - Knowledge of industry best practices and trends in learning science, talent strategy, and effective measurement of leadership development. - Leadership experience and experience leading organisational transformation work across stakeholder matrices. - Strong coaching skills, process facilitation skills, and practical experience working with team development. - Data-driven decision-making and evaluation skills.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,600 to 1,091,600 DKK.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Working at Novo Nordisk

Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with an unconventional spirit, a rare determination and a constant curiosity. For over 100 years this unordinary mindset has seen us build a company unlike any other. One where a collective passion for our purpose, mutual respect and a willingness to go beyond what we know delivers extraordinary results

**What We Offer

**There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

**Deadline

**20 November, 2026.

**Job Description

**

Global Business Development Manager

Posting Start Date: 10/8/26

Gentofte, DNK, 2820,

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark

Working hours: Full-time

Work model: Hybrid

Contract type: Permanent

**About The Role

**We are excited to offer an incredible opportunity for a Business Development Manager to join Scandinavian Tobacco Group’s growing Next Generation Products team. In this pivotal role, you will be essential in supporting our innovative ventures beyond tobacco, using strategic insights and a strong understanding of global market trends. Moreover, you will be responsible for shaping and managing our global product portfolio while identifying strategic business opportunities to drive global growth. You will work cross-functionally to deliver and execute portfolio strategies & business development opportunities that help grow our brands and company.

Your role as a self-reliant professional is crucial in our fast-paced environment. A key part of your role will involve ensuring clear communication and alignment within the organization, while fostering robust professional relationships. You will be reporting to the Head of Business Development.

**WHAT WILL YOU BE RESPONSIBLE FOR?

****Lead Category Development

**

• Develop and implement comprehensive strategies for next generation products, ensuring alignment with consumer preferences and market trends.

• Analyzing market trends, consumer preferences, and competitor activities to identify opportunities and threats for the brand and category portfolio to improve performance & profitability.

• Evaluate the performance of the portfolio and adjust as needed to ensure it continues to deliver growth and profitability.

**Business Growth & Development

**

• Identify and evaluate new business opportunities, including market expansions, strategic partnerships, and potential acquisitions.

• Lead cross-functional teams to develop and execute business development initiatives that accelerate revenue growth and expand market presence.

• Leverage data and market insights to continuously evolve the product portfolio, ensuring the company remains ahead of industry trends.

• Utilize market research and consumer insights for the development of the next generation products portfolio strategy and to define its role and roadmap.

**Global Collaboration

**

• Work closely with regional and local teams to adapt portfolio strategies to local market needs and ensure the successful global rollout of new products.

• Ensure a cohesive approach to portfolio management and business development across markets, driving synergies and efficiencies globally.

**New Business Opportunities

**

• Identify and assess emerging trends and consumer needs to develop new product categories that align with the company's strategic goals.

• Lead the exploration and validation of new business ideas through market research, pilot programs, and feasibility studies.

• Develop business cases for new category initiatives, including market analysis, financial projections, and risk assessments.

• Collaborate with R&D, marketing, and sales teams to bring new product categories from concept to market launch.

• Establish strategic partnerships and alliances to support the development and growth of new categories.

• Monitor and evaluate the performance of new categories, making data-driven adjustments to ensure their success and profitability.

**WHAT SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE WILL BE REQUIRED?

**

• 3-5 years of experience in business development and/or project management, ideally within multinational FMCG companies. Global/regional experience is preferred.

• Strong analytical skills and strategic thinking with a track record of identifying and capitalizing on growth opportunities.

• Deep understanding of consumer behaviour, what drives their decisions and how we can adjust our strategies to fit their needs and expectations.

• Excellent project management skills, with experience leading cross-functional teams & influence senior stakeholders.

• Strong communication and relationship-building abilities across diverse global teams.

• Good Excel and PowerPoint skills and proven experience in utilizing data analytics tools.

• Fluency in English and ability to travel up 10-15% of the time.

**Hands-on Game Director for WHAT THE CAR?

**Do you love working in small, creative teams turning wild ideas into a reality? Do you thrive on community feedback? Could you ensure an already loved comedy game remains goofy in all the right ways? Awesome. We need to talk!

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

WHAT THE CAR? is our absurdly silly racing adventure game which addresses fundamental questions such as… What if a car had legs? Or a jetpack? Or secretly identified as a sailboat? First launched in 2023 on Apple Arcade and now also on Steam, it has gained a steady following of dedicated fans who have contributed hundreds of thousands of community-built levels.

We’re looking for a Game Director to grab the creative wheel (sorry) on a small but mighty team to help steer CAR into the future. You’ll guide decisions on which jokes are worth pursuing, how we maintain and push quality and which turns to take along the road. You'll work closely with studio creative leadership and external partners to help define the future of CAR and to explore opportunities to reach even bigger audiences.

If you’re already rethinking what a car is, keep reading!

**Here’s What You'll Do Day To Day

**

• Take product responsibility for WHAT THE CAR? and ensure that it remains true to and evolves upon the existing WHAT THE? universe

• Along with studio leadership, define the game’s ongoing vision, strategy and goals

• Effectively communicate the vision within the team to enable team and individual autonomy

• Work closely with the Producer and team to create achievable product roadmaps built upon a humanistic approach to production

• Contribute directly to project development, such as creating prototypes, implementing gameplay or building levels in-engine

• Facilitate team-wide creative processes which ensure all ideas have been heard and the best solutions are agreed and understood

• Ensure we maintain a high quality bar across the game, and help catch what’s not working before it ships

• Be part of nurturing a creative, inclusive, high performing, high trust team culture

• Immerse yourself in user feedback, turning what players tell us into decisions about where the game goes next

**You’re a great match if

**

• You bring 8+ years working in creative product lead roles

• You’ve worked on at least 3 commercial and shipped game projects

• You are extremely familiar with one or more commercial game engines, including Unity

• You're a born communicator and collaborator who enjoys working closely with every member of a team

• You understand and appreciate the WHAT THE? universe and are excited to be an integral part of its future

• You use AI to boost workflows and productivity, giving you more time to focus on the important creative decisions

• You prefer to “show don’t tell” by demonstrating ideas through prototypes over endless design discussions

• You have experience working on family-friendly titles for a casual audience

**Nice to have

**

• Experience coding in C#

• Experience with game design for a live game

• Experience in the mobile premium space

**What Always Matters To Us At Triband

**

• You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

• You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness and creativity while actively contributing to sustaining that culture

• You believe games are made by teams, not rockstars and that great ideas can come from anyone

• You bring curiosity, generosity, and flexibility, along with strong opinions, especially when they come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to actually test them

• You love exploration and experimentation but don’t get too precious when the evidence tells you you’re wrong

• You value a positive work environment and contribute to keeping the studio a fun and supportive place to be

**Practicalities

**

• Role based in our cozy office in central Copenhagen

• We want to make sure we find the right person, so we also consider people located outside of Denmark and provide financial (and moral!) relocation support

• This team works with an office-first hybrid model: primarily working together in office with occasional remote working

• We work a 37-hour work week with flexible working hours

• Our working language is English

**We offer

**

• The opportunity to define and shape the future of a beloved game together with a closely knit team where everyone is actively participating in the creative process

• A playful work environment where trying the silly idea is encouraged

• Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games

• A professional development budget to invest in your growth

• Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, and whatever else Tribanders turn into a tradition

• Daily lunch at a local restaurant, with plant-based options and soft ice on Thursdays

• Private health insurance paid by us

• Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked

• Endless amounts of Club Mate

**WHAT THE TRIBAND?

**Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide.

From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make people laugh. We explore comedy through gameplay, which means we like to break player expectations, create surprising interactions, use great music and slick art, and build quirky worlds full of personality.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games. And we believe diversity makes teams better. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and who are excited to challenge us and our way of doing things.

For more info about Triband, check out: triband.net/about

Architect the future Finance platform that will power our global growth!

At KK Group, we are building the next generation of our global Finance landscape with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operation at its core.

As we continue to grow through both expansion and acquisitions, we are investing in a modern and integrated Finance platform that supports business growth, operational excellence, and data-driven decision-making.

We are looking for a Senior Finance Solution Architect who wants more than a traditional ERP role. This is an opportunity to influence strategy, architecture, business transformation, and M&A integration while helping shape the future of Finance technology at KK Group.

Your impact

You will be the lead architect for the Finance domain, with primary responsibility for D365 Finance and the wider Finance application landscape.

You will:

• Develop architecture across D365 Finance and the surrounding Finance systems landscape, ensuring scalable and integrated solutions that support growth, transformation, and M&A activities.

• Drive the evolution of D365 Finance as KK's strategic ERP platform.

• Define the Finance technology roadmap together with Finance and IT leadership.

• Lead architecture decisions across ERP, planning, reporting, treasury, tax, banking, data, and automation solutions.

• Support ERP rollouts, Finance transformation initiatives, and M&A integrations.

• Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, and implementation partners.

• Drive standardization, simplification, and scalable solution design.

• Explore opportunities within AI, Power Platform, Dataverse, analytics, and automation.

What we're looking for

• Strong experience with Microsoft Dynamics Finance & Operations.

• Experience as a Solution Architect, Enterprise Architect, or Senior Functional Architect.

• Deep understanding of Finance processes and ERP platforms.

• Experience with large transformation programmes and enterprise integrations.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Ability to combine strategic thinking with hands-on solution design.

• Experience with Power Platform, Dataverse, Data & Analytics, AI, or M&A integrations is an advantage.

Location

This role is based in our office in Ikast with flexibility for hybrid work. However remote work options can be arranged for qualified candidates residing in Denmark. Remote candidates should be able to travel to Ikast on regular basis.

Why join KK Group?

• Own a strategically important domain with high visibility.

• Influence the future Finance technology landscape of a global organization.

• Play a key role in integrating acquired businesses into a common platform and operating model.

• Work across ERP, Data, AI, and Digital Transformation initiatives.

• Shape architecture decisions with a direct business impact.

• Be part of a strong D365FO Solution architect & Project Manager department

• Join a company investing in modern Microsoft technologies and long-term platform thinking.

If you are motivated by ownership, transformation, and the opportunity to shape a global Finance technology landscape, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today and help us shape the technology foundation of tomorrow. Send us your resume in English and help us design the solutions of tomorrow. Interviews will be scheduled on an ongoing basis.

Further information:

For further information on the position, please contact Henrik Nørgaard Veng at henve@kkgroup.com.

About KK Group

Building on more than 40 years of experience, KK Group is a leading systems supplier to the renewable energy industry. Our capabilities span developing state-of-the-art technologies, high-quality lean manufacturing, and flexible aftermarket services. KK Group is owned by A.P. Moller Holding, the parent company of the A.P. Moller Group, established in 1904 by Arnold Peter Møller. We are a global and diverse team of over 4,000 people, working towards delivering products and services that enable a future powered by renewable energy.

At KK Group, our culture and DNA are built on a foundation of can-do attitude and innovation. We actively foster an inclusive work environment that embraces diversity, rejects any form of discrimination, and provides equal opportunities for all people. Our commitment lies in cultivating a strong culture centred around health, safety, wellbeing, and effective teamwork

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Veo you will get to work on challenging problems and directly contribute to the value created by our AI-driven end-user products.

You will become part of our AI team, which comprises 20+ researchers and engineers responsible for all stages in the machine learning lifecycles across different projects - from scoping and defining data annotation tasks to modeling, validation, and deployment. You will be free to determine the directions of the project you work on while also getting feedback and being encouraged to spar with the rest of the team to assist each other in improving and succeeding.

We stay current with the latest research and continuously discuss concepts and ideas in recent papers to assess their relevance to our tasks and product-specific challenges.

We are looking to add yet another ambitious, high-performing junior to mid-level engineer or/researcher with proven experience from real-world machine learning projects to the team. Experience with computer vision is advantageous but not a must.

**What you will do:

**

• Train state-of-the-art machine learning models

• Write efficient inference pipelines for cloud and edge

• Define and supervise data annotation tasks

• Improve evaluation schemes to increase understanding of model performance and shortcomings

• Contribute to long-term planning and prioritization of tasks

**What you will need:

**

• MSc or PhD in a relevant field

• Hands-on experience with real-world, large-scale machine-learning projects

• Great coding skills

• Skilled at both autonomous tasks and contributing to group efforts

• Ability to examine details closely and critically

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger

outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to make meaningful contributions.

jobs.occupation: Nail Technicians for a new salon in Aarhus
jobs.description:
📍 New beauty salon in the heart of Aarhus is looking for Nail Technicians!

Are you an experienced Nail Technician ready for a new challenge in a modern salon?

We are recruiting talented Nail Technicians for a modern and newly established beauty salon located in the heart of Aarhus.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing beauty team, work in a stylish professional environment and develop your career.

Clients walk straight in through the door, so you can spend all your time on what you do best!

💅 Your role – What will you be doing?

As a Nail Technician, your daily responsibilities will include:

• Performing professional manicures and pedicures.

• Applying gel polish to hands and feet.

• Creating nail extensions, refills and overlays.

• Performing French manicures and baby boomer designs.

• Creating beautiful nail art and customised decorations.

• Advising clients on nail treatments and styles.

• Providing excellent customer service.

• Maintaining high standards of hygiene and quality.

You will work in a walk-in salon concept, meaning clients come directly into the salon without appointments.

No need to find your own clients or manage your own booking calendar – you can focus on what you do best!

✨ What we offer

• A position in a modern, newly established beauty salon in central Aarhus.

• A welcoming and professional working environment.

• Modern equipment and a wide selection of nail products and colours.

• An established walk-in customer concept.

• No responsibility for finding clients or managing bookings.

• Full-time employment, with working hours arranged individually.

• Salary based on your qualifications and professional experience.

💰 Conditions

• Salary: From DKK 20,800 gross per month. The final salary will depend on your experience, skills and qualifications.

• Opening hours: Monday–Saturday, 10:00–19:00

• Working schedule: Agreed individually

👩🎨 Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must:

• Hold a valid EU/EEA passport.

• Have at least 1 year of demonstrable professional experience as a Nail Technician.

• Speak intermediate English (B1 or above).

• Have practical experience with gel nails, acrylic, nail extensions and professional manicure treatments.

• Be able to perform high-quality, long-lasting nail treatments.

• Be efficient, precise and detail-oriented.

• Be friendly, service-minded and comfortable working with customers.

• Live in the Aarhus area or be ready to move here.

🚀 Ready for a fresh start in Aarhus?

Imagine developing your career in a modern salon, with new colleagues and clients in one of Denmark's most vibrant cities.

You bring your skills and passion for nails. We give you a modern salon and clients who come to you!

Apply today! We look forward to meeting you :)

Actona Group operates in a dynamic and fast-changing commercial environment, where access to relevant data and the ability to translate it into actionable insights are increasingly important for commercial decision-making. As part of the Pricing & Commercial Excellence team, you will take on a central role in strengthening the commercial organisation through pricing, analytics, performance management and the continued development of commercial tools and processes.

The position combines a strong analytical and hands-on focus with the opportunity to contribute to the broader development of Commercial Excellence across Actona Group.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of data, pricing and commercial decision-making. A key responsibility will be to understand Actona’s pricing model in depth, take ownership of the technical solution behind it and ensure that management decisions related to pricing are effectively implemented. Alongside this, you will identify, collect and analyse relevant commercial data and turn your findings into concrete recommendations and initiatives. You will work with both structured and unstructured data, which calls for an investigative mindset and the ability to find relevant information even when it is not readily available.

At the same time, you will contribute to Actona’s broader Commercial Excellence agenda by developing and evaluating tactical commercial initiatives, supporting performance management and continuously improving the tools and processes that strengthen commercial execution.

Key responsibilities include:

• 
Maintain and further develop Actona’s pricing model and technical pricing solution

• 
Develop analyses, scenarios and decision-support tools to support commercial and pricing decisions

• 
Analyse price and margin development and identify commercial opportunities, risks and areas requiring action

• 
Translate commercial data and insights into concrete initiatives and recommendations

• 
Develop and analyse tactical commercial campaigns and follow up on their commercial impact

• 
Support commercial performance management by identifying opportunities, gaps and areas of underperformance

• 
Prepare clear and decision-oriented material for commercial management and relevant stakeholders

• 
Continuously develop analytical tools, methods and Commercial Excellence processes

• 
Explore how AI and other digital solutions can support commercial analyses, processes and decision-making

• 
Contribute to the implementation of a new CRM system, helping shape commercial processes and strengthen the use of data and insights across the organisation

Success in the role means that you are able to turn complex commercial information into analyses and recommendations that create value for the sales organisation. You drive and coordinate commercial initiatives across the organisation and locations, help sales directors focus and prioritise through relevant analyses, and ensure that pricing decisions are translated accurately and efficiently into the pricing model and commercial execution.

You have experience from areas such as pricing, Commercial Excellence, business analytics, BI, strategy, consulting or finance. You are comfortable working hands-on with data and commercial analysis and, importantly, know how to turn complex information into clear, actionable insights for commercial organisation.

You hold a relevant Master’s degree within engineering, mathematics, economics, business, finance or a similar field. You are highly proficient in Excel and experienced with Power BI or comparable BI tools, and you are comfortable working with complex datasets and developing analytical solutions. An interest in AI and emerging digital tools is an advantage. You are fluent in Danish and English, both written and spoken, and you communicate insights clearly to different audiences.

You are curious, commercially minded and able to create structure in a dynamic environment. You collaborate effectively across stakeholders, communicate clearly and maintain progress as priorities shift.

Actona’s culture is defined by three core values: Acceleration, Customer-Centricity and Trust. They believe in responsibility, collaboration and continuous improvement – and offer a work environment where people are encouraged to challenge, learn, and grow. You will get to work closely with decision-makers, contribute to strategic initiatives, and help shape how data is used across a global organisation.

Location: Holstebro

Travel: Up to 15 days per year

Take the next step in your career

Actona is collaborating with GML on this recruitment. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Researcher Kenny Byriel Thimsen at kt@gml-hr.dk. All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

Actona Group is an international furniture company headquartered in Holstebro, Denmark, with operations in more than 90 countries and production facilities across Europe and Asia. Rooted in strong entrepreneurial values, we combine commercial drive, speed of execution and a pragmatic mindset.

Are you an experienced climate and restoration leader ready to shape strategy and turn it into practical results? Do you enjoy developing services, building partnerships and bringing international teams together around shared goals? If so, this role could be the right fit for you.

What You Can Expect

Preferred by Nature is looking for a Director of Climate and Restoration to lead our Climate and Restoration Programme within the Sustainability Certification division and coordinate climate and restoration work across our Advisory, Certification and Projects divisions.

Reporting to the Sustainability Certification Director, you will combine strategic and technical leadership with programme management, service development and external engagement. Our certification programme currently covers carbon project validation and verification, ecosystem restoration services, and verification of organisational and product carbon footprints. You will help this portfolio evolve in response to climate science, standards, regulation and market needs.

You will also lead our Climate Impact initiative, translating our ambition to build a strong portfolio of mitigation and adaptation services by 2028 into coordinated workplans and measurable progress.

Working with us is never routine, so in your first year you can expect the following areas to be central to your work.

• Lead the Climate and Restoration Programme, ensuring effective service delivery and progress towards financial and impact targets.

• Shape organisation-wide priorities for climate and restoration, aligning services, projects and expertise across divisions and regions.

• Develop services and delivery approaches that respond to stakeholder needs and create meaningful environmental and social impact.

• Oversee the systems, tools, templates and technical guidance needed for accreditation and credible service delivery.

• Build strategic relationships with clients, companies, NGOs, governments, donors, producers and assurance schemes.

• Identify and pursue business development, partnership and fundraising opportunities.

• Represent Preferred by Nature in conferences, technical networks, industry initiatives and other external forums.

• Lead and develop your team through clear priorities, capacity planning, regular feedback and professional development.

• Contribute to strategic planning, programme budgets, financial monitoring and reporting.

Your first year with us:

Within Three Months, You Will

• Develop a clear understanding of our climate and restoration portfolio, team capabilities, accreditation requirements and current commitments.

• Build working relationships with colleagues across Certification, Advisory, Projects and regional teams, alongside key external stakeholders.

• Review the Climate Impact roadmap and identify priorities, dependencies and opportunities for coordinated action.

**_Within six months, you will:

_**

• Translate agreed strategic priorities into workplans with clear responsibilities, resource needs and progress measures.

• Work with relevant teams to advance priority service development, partnership and market engagement opportunities.

• Establish regular programme reviews covering delivery quality, financial performance, impact and team capacity.

• Put development priorities and training plans in place for your team.

**Within twelve months, you will:

**

• Demonstrate progress against the agreed Climate Impact workplan and programme objectives.

• Have advanced priority services or partnerships that strengthen Preferred by Nature’s climate and restoration portfolio.

• Strengthen coordination across divisions, with clear ownership and effective use of technical expertise.

• Provide recommendations for the next planning cycle based on programme results, market developments and lessons learned.

**Important that you:

**

• Have at least 10 years of relevant professional experience, including substantial experience in senior leadership, programme development, stakeholder engagement and climate or restoration services.

• Bring deep knowledge of climate mitigation, carbon markets, ecosystem restoration and related policy, market and regulatory developments.

• Have a proven ability to set strategic direction and lead complex initiatives across multiple teams and stakeholder groups.

• Can build alignment and deliver results in an international organisation where colleagues work across different functions and reporting lines.

• Have experience developing strategic partnerships and identifying opportunities that support organisational impact and growth.

• Bring professional credibility in the climate, carbon, restoration or wider sustainability sector, including experience representing an organisation in senior external forums.

• Understand business development and fundraising, and have experience contributing to budgets and financial management.

• Can lead and develop people, support teams through change and encourage collaboration, learning and accountability.

• Combine an entrepreneurial approach with practical judgement and a focus on measurable results.

• Share Preferred by Nature’s commitment to positive environmental and social impact.

**Would also be great, but not necessary, if you:

**

• Have worked across several areas of our current portfolio, such as carbon project validation and verification, ecosystem restoration, and organisational or product carbon footprints.

• Have experience connecting assurance services, advisory work and project delivery within a shared organisational strategy.

_If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you!

_**What Sets Us Apart

**

• Global work culture

• High degree of flexibility – remote work, work from home.

• An in-depth onboarding and professional training that prepares you with the right skills and knowledge to thrive in this role.

• Excellent opportunities for growth and professional development

• Potential future international travel opportunities

• A friendly, international team of colleagues, with a pleasant work environment

• Start with 20 days of vacation leave per year

**Preferred by Nature

**Preferred by Nature is a non-profit, mission-driven organisation that works for sustainable land management and climate-friendly solutions. We develop practical solutions to drive positive impacts in production landscapes and supply chains, supporting better land management and business practices that benefit people, nature and the climate.

**How To Apply

**If you feel you meet the requirements of the role, please submit your application, including salary expectations, via the application form below. Application pre-screening will be conducted during the application period.

Preferred by Nature wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

At e-conomic, we build the leading cloud-based accounting platform trusted every day by over 300 000 businesses to keep their finances accurate, streamlined, and compliant.

Within our Accounting Automation value stream, you will join Team Apex, the engineering unit at the core of our accounting engine. Our mission is critical: delivering platform stability, managing high-volume transactional data and automating complex financial workflows. We work on a mature, business-critical platform where precision matters, and we are actively modernizing it - a great fit for engineers who enjoy improving real systems at scale and building new things, with AI tools as part of everyday work.

Why this role?

Team Apex sits at the absolute core of e-conomic: our system processes the mission-critical financial transactions that tens of thousands of businesses rely on every single day.

There is a lot ahead of us. We want to build both great user experience and handle huge amounts of data, and to do that we need more front-end muscle and someone who enjoys making busy backend and database run smoothly.

This role exists to bridge that gap. As a Full Stack Engineer, you will not just pick up tickets; you will be the technical catalyst who raises our team's delivery pace, balances our front-end and back-end capabilities, and mentors engineers to keep our core platform rock-solid and future-ready.

Your missions

On a day-to-day and sprint-to-sprint basis, you will:

• 
Build full-stack product features: Ship end-to-end capabilities within the accounting domain, writing clean React on the front end and robust C# on the back end.

• 
Optimize high-volume SQL data: Profile slow queries, optimize relational schemas, and resolve performance bottlenecks across heavy transactional tables.

• 
Lead small feature pods: Autonomously run project tracks and pair with developers to drive design discussions and unblock technical dependencies.

• 
Drive code quality & knowledge sharing: Review PRs, set new standards, pair program, and actively contribute to company-wide engineering guilds.

• 
Participate in support duty rotations: Take turns in weekly support rotations to diagnose edge cases, investigate bugs, and handle cross-department inquiries.

The environment

• 
The team setup: You will collaborate closely with a multidisciplinary group composed of 8 developers, 2 QA engineers. On project level, dedicated UX and Product Manager.

• 
Hybrid working style: We spend 3 days a week together in our Copenhagen office for whiteboarding, architecture discussions, pair programming, and planning, but also for shared lunches, good chats, and a bit of fun along the way.

• 
AI-first engineering mindset: Exploring and adopting modern AI coding tools is actively encouraged and integrated into daily work routines.

• 
Tech stack: React, C# / .NET, large-scale relational databases (SQL), CI/CD pipelines, and modern SRE/cloud infrastructure interfaces.

What you bring

Need-to-have:

• 
Proven hands-on experience building modern, responsive web applications using React.

• 
Solid background in C# / .NET developing robust back-end systems.

• 
Strong command of relational databases and SQL, including query optimization, data indexing, and schema design.

• 
A collaborative mindset with clear, constructive communication and an appetite for mentoring peers.

• 
Professional working proficiency in English.

Nice-to-have:

• 
Prior experience with accounting software or other fintech systems

•
